originalCriteria: Account, contact, consent basis, segment, next action, status and qualification notes stored and permission-scoped.
Capture organization/contact, segment, permission basis, needs and qualification status.
Assign owner, next action and follow-up date without implying purchase commitment.
Restrict contact/negotiation access and honor retention/contact preferences.
Track stage history and distinguish lead, qualified opportunity, proposal and contracted customer.
implementation: Existing scoped discovery/qualification/contact histories retained; all-stage RFQ authorization is stricter.
tests: Full Batch12 HTTP and mobile/desktop regressions pass.
externalGate: Real contact-basis evidence and owner acceptance remain separate.

originalCriteria: Proposal versions and feedback documented; won deals link to RFQ or signed contract.
Version sample/pilot proposal scope, price, timing and responsibilities.
Record buyer objections, outcome, decision date and follow-up owner.
Require RFQ/contract evidence before marking a proposal won.
Preserve lost/no-decision reasons without overwriting earlier negotiation.
implementation: RFQ references persist at DRAFT/SENT/WON and cannot silently change/disappear; immutable historical JSON links remain read-compatible. No proposal creates artisan obligations.
tests: R12 missing/HOLD/REJECT, current approval, both WON orderings and browser proposal histories.
missingCriteria: None identified in the authorized RFQ conversion path.
externalGate: Real buyer outcomes and signed-contract evidence are not fabricated.

originalCriteria: Quote versus actual variance, buyer payment milestones, obligations and minimum cash gap calculated per order.
Compare quoted versus actual revenue/cost lines with variance reasons.
Model timing of buyer receipts, material purchases and artisan obligations.
Show minimum cash gap and assumptions without conflating contribution with cash.
Require finance review before committing to an unfunded or unsustainable new contract.
implementation: A12-02 repaired: acceptance requires exact current quote/cost/feasibility/RFQ/funding review for linked RFQs or explicit finance-reviewed RFQs.
tests: Four new permanent funding checks; missing, HOLD/UNFUNDED, REJECT, stale assumptions/cost/quote and concurrent idempotent acceptance.
missingCriteria: Supported actual recognized contribution and complete actual cost/revenue evidence remain unavailable.
externalGate: Approved recognition definitions, complete actual evidence and funding-policy ownership.

originalCriteria: Exports balance to source events and restrict sensitive details.
Export period, account/order reference, currency, amount and source event with stable IDs.
Reconcile totals to invoice, receipt, liability and payout subledgers.
Separate pending/simulated records from verified transactions.
Limit sensitive beneficiary details and audit who exported which period.
implementation: Existing source-based, scoped, audited accounting CSV preserved; no second ledger or invoice mapping added.
tests: Existing independent source-liability and cost reconciliation plus full browser/export regression.
externalGate: Approved invoice/tax policy and source evidence.

originalCriteria: On-time rate excludes missing/unknown denominators, distinguishes planned from completed, and identifies unverified payout dates.
Derive due dates from accepted contractual rules rather than report creation dates.
Compute on-time numerator/eligible denominator with explicit reporting period.
Distinguish outstanding overdue, settled late, on-time and unknown/unverified dates.
Define treatment of partial payments and disputed obligations and disclose exclusions.
implementation: A12-03 software preparation: append-only ContractualDueDate source/correction history, exact terms-version binding, and separate operational/reported/simulated states. No free-text date parsing or verified-payment fabrication.
tests: Three permanent native/HTTP checks, two new units and the extended real browser due-date/partial-report journey. Existing pure verified-case tests remain model tests only.
missingCriteria: Verified-positive service settlement remains unavailable under the preserved execution_unverified constraint.
externalGate: Approved bank/provider/manual settlement-verification policy and genuine source evidence; positive states require that authority.

originalCriteria: Closure blocks on unreconciled receivables, undisposed material costs, outstanding payables or open settlement disputes unless explicit authorized exception.
Check buyer receivables, all artisan obligations, settlement disputes and material dispositions.
Block closure when a required balance/evidence remains unresolved.
Require a documented authorized and lawful disposition for any exception without erasing liability history.
Record closure checklist, actor, time and ledger snapshot atomically.
implementation: A12-01 repaired: one transaction-bound FinanceService.assess gates the legacy CLOSED transition and finance decision; related adjustments, receivables, stock, payables, sample obligations and events cannot be bypassed.
tests: Exact pending-adjustment HTTP 409 counterexample; material/payable/dispute/partial buyer evidence; concurrent adjustment/close; repeat/exception denial; linked sample regression.
missingCriteria: Lawful positive financial close and authorized exceptions remain disabled. Pure source-free synthetic legacy behavior is explicitly separate from verified settlement.
externalGate: Approved settlement, entitlement, material disposition, invoice and lawful exception policies.

originalCriteria: Recovery target, log redaction and alert tests documented.
Define reviewed recovery-time/recovery-point targets and backup ownership.
Produce protected backups and execute a restore into an isolated environment.
Capture structured redacted logs, health checks and actionable alerts.
Document incident/rollback procedures and verify restored ledger consistency.
implementation: Existing encrypted backup/restore and native migration verification reused, now with populated contractual-date history.
tests: 36 native migrations; 131-table restore including all new date rows; row hashes, constraints, rollback/history and normal upgrade regression pass.
missingCriteria: No missing local software criterion identified.
externalGate: Hosted/off-site recoverability, named production ownership, key custody and actual RTO/RPO validation remain separate.

originalCriteria: Per-data-class retention, deletion exceptions, access roles and breach reporting ownership reviewed before real pilot.
Define per-class purpose, retention trigger/duration, access roles and deletion method.
Document required finance/audit exceptions and approve them through qualified review.
Assign privacy incident detection, escalation and response owners.
Verify expiry/removal behavior for personal data and approved public copies.
Keep wearable raw/summary records absent from commercial retention inventories except a documented local-only boundary.
implementation: Existing governed inventory and no-destructive-purge boundary preserved. New date evidence belongs to the financial-record purpose class.
tests: Existing retention authorization/no-purge and privacy regressions pass.
missingCriteria: Retention durations, preservation exceptions, named responsibilities and removal procedures need qualified review.
externalGate: Qualified privacy/legal policy review; no Tunisian compliance or production approval asserted.
